effects.title: 2.5D 照片视差 (#2, VoluMax/Photomotion; MDMZ 1171万播放)

effects.title: 形状元素爆发 (Shape Elements burst)

effects.title: 重拍排版 Stomp (#4, TypoKing 1.34万份; B站动态歌词排版 898万)
effects.how: one word per beat slams full-frame, sizes alternate, every third beat inverts the frame; a 2-frame jolt on each hit. With narration timestamps each word lands the moment it is spoken (like lyric typography).
effects.ref: TypoKing 1.34万份 · B站动态歌词排版 898万播放
effects.label: #4 重拍排版 · Stomp
effects.suit: 节奏快的一句话、金句拆字

effects.title: 行遮罩上移 (the most-used title reveal)
effects.how: each line rises out of its own mask, expo.out.
effects.label: #5 遮罩上滑 · Mask Reveal

effects.title: 照片墙拼合 (#6, Mosaic Photo Reveal 1.6万份)
effects.how: 12 tiles fly in from depth and assemble a wall, then the camera pushes into one tile until it fills the frame.
effects.label: #6 照片墙拼合 · Mosaic Reveal

effects.title: 卡通冲击特效 (#7, 140 Flash FX 1.47万份)
effects.how: speed lines, a jagged impact star, smoke puffs — on twos (12 fps steps).

effects.title: 苹果式逐字模糊渐显 (#9, 206.8万 2025)
effects.how: each glyph fades up out of a soft blur and a small rise, grey→white.

effects.title: 瞳孔穿梭 / 穿洞推进 (#10, B站364.5万 2025)

effects.title: 霓虹点亮 (#12, Neon Sign Kit 1万份)
effects.how: tube text stutters on (stepped flicker pattern), then holds with a steady glow.

effects.how: a dot pops on the subject, the leader line draws out, the label slides along it.

effects.how: each digit column spins down to its value, staggered.

effects.how: glyph outlines draw on, then the fill floods in.

effects.title: 文字匹配剪辑 Text Match Cut (#23, Envato Elements 标题热门第1/2)
effects.how: the word holds its exact place while everything around it hard-cuts — background, colour field and typeface change every few frames. Each cut is a designed pair (ground + type treatment), so the word always reads.
effects.ref: Envato Elements 标题热门第1、2名
effects.label: #23 文字匹配剪辑 · Text Match Cut

effects.title: 冲击抖动 (#24, Bricks 106.8万 2025)
effects.how: the title slams in and the whole frame takes a decaying camera shake.
effects.label: #24 冲击抖动 · Impact Shake

effects.title: 打字机 + 光标
effects.how: one glyph per 2 frames, blinking caret (deterministic blink on the timeline).
effects.ref: T5 · 科技 / 教程类必备
effects.label: 打字机 · Typewriter

effects.title: 乱码解码 (Decoder / Scramble)
effects.how: every slot is a reel of random glyphs that steps (not slides) onto its real character, slots settling left→right. Pure transforms with a steps() ease, so it seeks in any order.
effects.label: 乱码解码 · Decoder

effects.title: 字距收拢 (Tracking In)
effects.how: glyphs start spread wide and drift together while sharpening — done with transforms (x offset ∝ distance from the centre), so it never snaps to whole pixels like letter-spacing would.
effects.label: 字距收拢 · Tracking In

effects.title: 逐字三维翻转 (3D Flip per character)
effects.how: rotateX from -100°, transform-origin bottom, perspective on the line.
effects.label: 逐字三维翻转 · 3D Flip

effects.title: 巨型虚影背景字 (Ghost / outline background type)
effects.how: a huge outlined word drifts behind small foreground copy.
effects.label: 巨型虚影背景字 · Ghost Type
effects.suit: 章节标题 + 小字说明

effects.title: 中英双语锁定 + 注释引线 (type specimen lockup)
